meaning.en: (computing) A device or program capable of performing transformations on a data stream or signal.

meaning.en: An integrated circuit that converts analog data into digital and vice versa, used as to transmit images or sounds.

meaning.en: A software program that encodes data or a signal for later decoding to view or listen to, used as to transmit or store images or sounds.
